name: Nursing Students in a Hands-On Clinical Setting
notes: This image shows diverse nursing students in a hands-on clinical setting, engaging with patients and utilizing medical equipment in a realistic healthcare environment. It captures the enthusiasm and professionalism of future healthcare professionals, making it suitable for the program landing page, ads, email campaigns, and social media. The environment reflects the hybrid learning experience of the Associate of Science in Nursing program, showcasing practical application and the supportive community of the American Healthcare Institute.
